protocol.source: User-described Xiaohongshu method; source platform candle alignment unknown
protocol.outside: Current HIGH>previousHIGH and LOW<previousLOW; both positive-volume completed bars. Primary full-range outside, not body-only engulfing.
protocol.direction: Bull close>open and close>EMA20 ->long; bear close<open and close<EMA20 ->short. Do not require previous candle opposite in primary.
protocol.ema: 20 close SMA seed then alpha2/21 recursion; no signal before20 completed bars
protocol.entry: Next bar first executed minute open plus adverse slip; if zero-volume first minute, wait for its first trade within next bar; risk checked then; no invented fill on zero volume
protocol.initialStop: Outside bar extreme:low forlong/high forshort. Never tighten initial stop to force1lot inside3000budget.
protocol.trailing: Initial stop outside extreme; after each completed chosen-timeframe bar update long stop=max(old,min(last3 lows)), short=min(old,max(last3highs)). Only favorable moves; no future/in-progress bar.
protocol.intraday: No new after14:45/02:15; exit14:55/02:25; same as preexisting discipline.
protocol.conditionalTrend: At14:55/02:25, hold only last completed chosen-timeframe barclose remains onEMA20 side, margin sufficient, no scheduledmajor event in next24h and no>12h closure gap
protocol.signalSensitivity: Also report previous-bar-opposite-color definition, as a separate labeled variant. No selection/promotion based on full-period winner.
protocol.eventPolicy: 78-source calendar same as factor study, FOMC/minutes2h,CPI/NFP/PCE/GDP1h before/after, original+revised whereverified; historicalschedule-vintage limitation remains

aggregationDetail.trading_minutes: Within each trading day, accumulate actual1m exchange-time slots, spanning breaks. Final shorter bucket completed at15:00. No price adjustment or contract roll.
aggregationDetail.session_clock: Night anchored21:00 to02:30, day09:00 to15:00 wall clock. Empty breaks ignored; session-end shorter buckets are explicitly counted.

protocol.evaluation: Full available contract since listing, each day replayed; historical results already inspected; not true prospective validation.
protocol.confirmedUserChoice: User explicitly chose previous3completedbar extremes, notEMA20 exit
